checked: Optional metadata remains additive under eval-report/v1, with no new dependencies.
Legacy gates and paired eligibility stay unchanged when both sides omit all four keys; the new evidence explicitly records unknown values.
Unexplained differences, one-sided observations and planned experiments are distinct, shared between baseline policy and matched-case analytics.
Intent declarations cannot invent missing values or waive dataset/rubric drift. Explicit baseline gate overrides do not make incompatible statistics eligible.
Human-readable reports prioritize differences before truncation; JSON keeps all 84 checks in the long-report regression.
HTML escapes values and reasons, Markdown uses safe code spans, and text strips control characters.

limits: Opaque version strings are compared, not independently verified.
Intent declarations do not prove experimental control or causality.
Full required verification is recorded by pnpm quality:record before commit.
These corrections are not in published npm 0.11.0.
